subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 1 8 2 9 7 6 2 4 8 3 4 6 1 9 4 2 7 4 3 5 9 8 3 5 2 4 8 (Right)

How many such even digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 1 8 2 9 7 6 2 4 8 3 4 6 1 9 4 2 7 4 3 5 9 8 3 5 2 4 8 (Right)

Now,

Even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90da4448a3315448191642a6ae7238219d086e726bfae6d02c0bd2c017a2bb2e.png] 

Thus, there are three even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
